releaseNotes: The tutorial now places each explanation in its own space in the page, so no other buttons are covered on phone, tablet or landscape screens.
Removed the glowing green pulse and extra white borders around highlighted controls; the app keeps its normal visual style.
The Shopping List tour explains that ingredients from the meals in My Week are added automatically and grouped ready to buy.
Removed repeated dinner/lunch day Settings steps; Settings now explains the supermarket, with budget and food preferences nearby.
Users still open tabs themselves, see smooth scrolling, can tap outside to continue, and can skip or replay the tour. Saved meals and shopping data remain untouched.
